package.description: A free desktop weather app. For the casual check-in or the deep dive.

en-US.description: A free desktop weather app. For the casual check-in or the deep dive.
en-US.longDescription: AccessiWeather brings forecasts, alerts, and detailed weather data into one open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It keeps current conditions, daily forecast, hourly forecast, and alerts in clearly separated sections so you can jump straight to what you need with speech, braille, or the keyboard.
en-US.name: AccessiWeather
